_comment: Rider release notes, newest first, shipped in the app (#97, #100). Sample copy from HW/WhatsNew until #97 fixes the shape and the owner writes the launch notes.

notes: Each earnings line shows the delivery fee and the tip.
Each payout lists the lines it is made of.
If a payout is on hold or does not go through, the Earnings tab tells you why and how to fix it.
The offer timer stays correct after your phone has been asleep.
Buzzer and unit numbers are larger and easier to read.
